text:
I fixed six bugs in `catalog/`, but I couldn't run `python3 -m unittest`. I have no shell in this session, so none of the fixes have been run against the suite. I checked each one by reading the code and the tests.

- **`fees.py`:** the late fee added the daily rate to the number of days. It now multiplies them.
- **`members.py`:** `MAX_BORROWED` was 3. The policy comment and the tests say 5, so I changed it.
- **`inventory.py`:** `recent(n)` returned `n + 1` events because of an off-by-one slice. It now returns the last `n`, and an empty list when `n` is 0 or less.
- **`factory.py`:** `sample_books()` was missing "Emma", so I added it.
- **`books.py`:** `parse_book` left the year as a string. It now converts it to an int.
- **`search.py`:** it imported `normalize` from `catalog.nonexistent`. It now imports it from `catalog.text`.

Please run `python3 -m unittest` to confirm everything passes.
